transform_assessment.origin_policy: Preserve current origin and armature space until landmark certification

symmetry_assessment.instruction: Do not mirror topology or weights automatically; build explicit bilateral landmark pairs and preserve authored asymmetry.

facial_surface.evidence: R2_Head_Face_Foundation; one connected island; 3654 vertices; 6847 faces

eyelids.evidence: No dedicated groups, attributes, bones, shape keys, or eye objects

eye_sockets.evidence: No dedicated ocular object or socket label

brows.evidence: No dedicated group, attribute, bone, or shape key

cheeks.evidence: Topology provenance attributes r2_v40_cheek_patch and r2_v40_cheek_side exist; not deformation labels

muzzle.evidence: Semantic source description includes muzzle but has no dedicated deformation attribute

nose.evidence: r2_v39_source_face_index and central_nasal_bridge lineage metadata exist

lips_and_mouth_boundary.evidence: Semantic source description includes mouth/jaw surface; no dedicated loop certificate

jaw.evidence: Existing armature has no jaw bone and surface has no jaw group

ears.evidence: Fur semantic metadata references areas near ears but no dedicated ear surface/group is certified

neck_attachment.evidence: Existing neck/head groups, parent R2_Rig, one Armature modifier, zero unweighted vertices

head_to_body_attachment.evidence: Existing root-to-head bone chain and exact head/neck weights

recommended_future_system.head_root: Use existing deform bone head under neck; add a non-deforming facial control root only after anatomical landmark approval.
recommended_future_system.jaw_structure: One anatomically certified jaw pivot/deform chain plus corrective shapes; do not create until hinge, chin, lip boundary, and mouth interior ownership are certified.
recommended_future_system.eye_controls: Require separate left/right eye objects or certified ocular centers before creating aim controls; none exist in the current source.
recommended_future_system.eyelid_approach: Hybrid: sparse lid-follow bones for large motion and shape keys for seal, blink, squint, and corneal conformity after lid-loop certification.
recommended_future_system.brow_controls: Sparse bilateral control/deform bones for broad arcs, with shape keys for local compression and asymmetrical nuance.
recommended_future_system.cheek_controls: Low-count bilateral deform controls for volume displacement plus corrective shapes coupled to jaw, smile, squint, and muzzle motion.
recommended_future_system.muzzle_controls: Certified bilateral and center controls preserving volume; use correctives at large jaw/lip combinations.
recommended_future_system.lip_controls: Hybrid controls with certified upper/lower and corner landmarks; shape keys own phoneme/contact detail, bones own broad placement.
recommended_future_system.ear_controls: Optional low-count deform chains only after dedicated ear ownership is proven; never bind generic fur islands by inference.
recommended_future_system.neck_integration: Preserve existing neck/head groups and chain; validate head turns, neck bends, and hood/fur interpenetration independently.
recommended_future_system.bone_vs_shape_key_responsibility: Bones: rigid pivots and broad regional motion. Shape keys: surface contact, folds, phonemes, eyelid seal, asymmetry, and corrective combinations.
recommended_future_system.corrective_strategy: Pose-space corrective shapes keyed by measured driver combinations; start from neutral Basis and never generate shapes automatically from unverified symmetry.
recommended_future_system.shape_key_readiness: Topology and vertex order are stable, but an approved neutral landmark map, naming schema, and regression signature are required before the first Basis/target creation.

glb_export_constraints: Preserve positive unit transforms and canonical names
Keep maximum four effective influences per vertex
Export only explicitly selected semantic assets
Keep morph target names deterministic and unique
Do not bake final animation in the foundation asset
Validate skin, hierarchy, vertex order, normals, and morph deltas after round trip
No final web GLB is authorized in this phase
